title: NFTStakerDepletion.finalizeAndReset revives pool to Active without re-arming the depletion window; organic stake earns zero until owner re-arm
description: finalizeAndReset revives a drained Migrating pool to Active (L778-784) but does NOT recompute the schedule. Post-story-020 stake() no longer auto-rearms the window, so a revive-then-organic-stake sequence (no depositFor re-seed via the migrator, which self-heals via its own tail recompute per L-01/DEDUP-19-006) emits ZERO rewards until the owner explicitly re-arms via setDepletionWindow / topUp. This is an INTENDED consequence of story-020 but a non-obvious operational footgun (Law 3): the InPlace migrator path self-heals while the organic path does not.
impact: None to assets (value never lost; principal untouched). Emissions PAUSE (not destroyed) after an organic revive until the owner re-arms. Fully owner-recoverable via setDepletionWindow/topUp. Low.
attackPath: 1. Pool is drained/Migrating; owner calls finalizeAndReset -> Active (no schedule recompute).
2. A new user stakes organically (plain stake(), NOT the migrator's self-healing depositFor path).
3. Because story-020 removed the stake tail recompute, windowEnd stays dormant -> the staker accrues nothing until the owner calls setDepletionWindow/topUp to re-arm.
4. Owner re-arms -> emissions resume. No value lost; only a silent emission gap until re-arm.
recommendation: Have finalizeAndReset re-arm the window (recompute the schedule on revive), OR emit an explicit NEEDS-REARM signal / document the required setDepletionWindow follow-up so the asymmetry with the self-healing depositFor path is not a silent footgun.
category: Low operational footgun (Law-3 non-obvious asymmetric consequence of the story-020 fix); Law-2 faithfulness cross-ref
